meta.title: Silver — SGGW computer science student club
meta.description: The computer science student club at SGGW. We build the apps the campus uses.

hero.title: The computer science club at SGGW.
hero.lead: The apps people use around campus are written by students at your faculty. You could build the next one with us.

steps.heading: Three steps to start

items.title: Join the Discord
items.body: The whole club lives on the Discord: projects, people, meetup dates. Say a few words about yourself and what you'd like to work on.

items.title: Pick a project or pitch your own
items.body: Get into something that's already running, or bring an idea of your own.

items.title: Work on it over a semester
items.body: On your own or in a small team, at your own pace. When it helps to sit down together, we meet in our room.

steps.hackathons: We compete at hackathons too. At HackArena 3.0 in March 2026 we made the final and finished 4th.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.lead: Apps and tools we build in the club. Chances are one of them is already on your phone.

build.heading: What we build, and how
build.cardTitle: How we pick and build projects
build.what: We take what annoys us at university and turn it into apps. That's how the timetable app and the campus map came about. The rest runs on curiosity and fun: a new technology to try, or a familiar idea done our own way.
build.how: We don't lock ourselves into one stack. Every project gets the tools that fit it, and we pick up new things early, sometimes before anyone calls them stable.

join.heading: Join
join.lead: Ever got a script for class, a website or a bot working? Then you've got the basics. You'll pick up the rest in a team.
join.threshold: We post meetup dates and current projects on the Discord. To start, just write to us there.
join.stripProjects: Got an idea for an app? Bring it, or join a project that's already running.
join.stripHistory: We post current projects and meetup dates on the Discord.

history.heading: History
history.lead: Since 2013: projects, workshops and hackathons, year by year.
